provenance: Populated from the maintainer's structured reading of the source, recorded 2026-09-09. This is NOT the output of a machine extraction pass: that pass requires the folder registered in ../local-context.md, which was not reachable from the run that created this file. extraction_note: The source PDF has NO text layer. Extraction requires rasterizing (pdftoppm at 300-600 dpi) and OCR (tesseract -l deu), then a manual read-back of every code, because an OCR error in a two-character code is undetectable downstream.
pending: The 20 main site classes (Hauptstellenarten), each with code and designation.
The 152 sub site classes (Unterstellenarten), each with code, designation and parent.
The collective classes *1 and *2 per main class.

structural_rules.detail: The sub-class codes *1 and *2 act as collective classes within a main class.
ZZ is the catch-all sub site class.
A block of codes is reserved for retail site classes.
The STA field `Stellenart` is 4 characters: two for the main class, two for the sub class.

digital_classes.note: The norm treats digital out-of-home as a set of object classes, not as a delivery model.

anomalies.anomaly: Three characters long, which does not fit the 4-character `Stellenart` field of the STA record.
Assigned twice — once as a main site class, and once as a sub site class under GF.
